title: Surreal Mirror Boat
description: A surreal scene features an ornate black mirror with a swirling orange vortex inside, from which three fairies in pink, blue, and purple emerge. Below, an orange boat floats on water, carrying several white cats, a crystal ball, and a large blue planet-like sphere with purple speckles. A small human figure stands on the sphere, while a red ringed planet and abstract doodles fill the background.
prompt: A surreal whimsical scene with an ornate black decorative mirror floating above an orange boat on water. Inside the mirror is an orange swirling vortex with three fairies flying out: one pink, one blue, and one purple. The boat carries several white cats, one holding a crystal ball. A large blue and purple speckled planet sphere sits in the boat with a tiny human figure standing on it. Background has a red ringed planet, abstract swirls, stars, and doodles in a hand-drawn illustrative style.
